patches.name: impact-i-a-32
patches.notes: THE TRITON SOUND — A-32 IMPACT. The piano-stab heard on more 2000s hip-hop records than any other preset. Layered piano + bell + bass triggered by single key. Range a1-a5. Used in: Drake 'In My Feelings', Cardi B 'Bodak Yellow', Just Blaze productions, ~80+ charting tracks. Producers chase this preset for the Jay-Z 'Heart of the City' era sound.

patches.name: mother-of-pearl
patches.notes: MOTHER OF PEARL (A-12) — atmospheric pad with shimmer, the 'Future R&B' pad. Slow attack, wide stereo. Range c2-c6. Used in: The Weeknd, Bryson Tiller, PartyNextDoor productions, all of OVO Sound late 2010s.

patches.name: rock-organ
patches.notes: ROCK ORGAN — Triton's Hammond-style B3 organ. With Leslie sim. Range a2-a5. Used in: 2000s rap-rock productions, hip-hop soul, R&B 'feeling-spirit' moments.

patches.name: studio-grand
patches.notes: STUDIO GRAND PIANO — Triton's signature acoustic piano patch. THE go-to piano sample for 2000s pop+R&B production. Range a1-a5. Used in: Beyoncé 'Halo', Alicia Keys productions, mainstream pop-soul.

patches.name: old-tape-rhodes
patches.notes: OLD TAPE RHODES — vintage EP impression with tape saturation character baked in. Range a1-a5. Used in: D'Angelo-era neo-soul productions, ?uestlove sets.

patches.name: smooth-strings
patches.notes: SMOOTH STRINGS (PRES) — lush legato strings. Range c2-c6. Used in: 2000s ballad backgrounds, hip-hop soul layering, Just Blaze epic-mode productions.

patches.name: 808-sub-bass
patches.notes: 808 SUB BASS — Triton's emulation of the TR-808 kick as a tuned sub. Range a0-a2. Used in: 2000s/2010s hip-hop, trap, Atlanta sound.

patches.name: lead-saw
patches.notes: LEAD SAW — Triton's classic supersaw lead. Range c3-c6. Used in: 2000s pop-rap leads, Timbaland productions, mainstream hip-hop hooks.

patches.name: fingerstyle-bass
patches.notes: FINGERSTYLE BASS — Triton's realistic fingered bass impression. Range a1-a3. Used in: 2000s R&B, neo-soul productions where you need a real-sounding bass but no live player.

patches.name: wide-pad
patches.notes: WIDE PAD — slow-attack atmospheric pad. Range c2-c6. Used in: ambient R&B intros, trap atmosphere layers, modern hip-hop production beds.

patches.name: kalimba
patches.notes: KALIMBA — thumb piano sample with attack snap. Range c3-c6. Used in: world-pop productions, Drake-era African-influenced hip-hop ('One Dance' vibe).

patches.name: drum-kit
patches.notes: Triton's stock drum kit — including the iconic kick + snare layers that defined a generation of hip-hop drum programming. One-shot capture per element.
